non-blocking: the paragraph says a second match 'measures a condition that has ended by the job's 4 h limit instead of the default it would otherwise carry', but the case it describes (tests/test_a_declared_wait_is_judged_against_itself.py:372-395) probes 'squeue -h -j 1317867 -o "%T %L"' and reports 'CANCELLED+ 01:02:03'; %L is the scheduler's remaining time, so the reverted reading yields 3723 s, not 14400 s, and the figure the shipped evidence names is not the one its own control measures. non-blocking: the extraction narrows what the live-state reader accepts as terminal.
